methods.label: Apply the reflected-point property
methods.explanation:
For two distinct points that are reflections of each other, the axis of reflection perpendicularly bisects the segment joining them.

If \(A\) lies on \(l\), then \(A'=A\), and the zero-length segment has no unique supporting line, so perpendicularity is undefined. Under the distinct-point convention \(A\ne A'\), \(l\) perpendicularly bisects \(AA'\), giving C.
methods.levelReason: This directly applies the Grade 8 reflection property. Its distinct-point condition and on-axis exception require only elementary geometry.
